findings.title: SVX registry raw receipts refer to the previous snapshot
findings.mechanism: Same source_id is used for context17 dated facts captured 2026-11-09 and context12 registry receipts captured 2026-11-08. Registry.raw_sha256 differs from dated_evidence.html_sha256 for all 129 SVX rows. Source lookup can select a different raw snapshot while appearing to validate the current rows.
findings.reproduction: Run independent.py; inspect FAIL SOURCE_REGISTRY_ROW_RAW_VERSION_FK and source_registry_mismatches.csv. Stage17 sources.json hashes match every affected row.
findings.minimum_fix: Pin context/17_aircraft_route_review/evidence/sources.json at exact93fa5cf4; bind inherited facts/cards to its hash and capture date. Keep any context12 snapshot separately identified. Rebuild registry/locks and dependent manifests/addendum receipts under a new commit. Do not rewrite raw, frozen outputs or clocks. Add source_id+raw_hash+capture-date foreign-key validation.

impact.held_acceptance: SOURCE_SUPPORTED / end-to-end raw lineage for affected rows/cards/links
